definitions.action_switch_rate: Changed movement actions divided by adjacent valid decisions in the same live slot/episode; last action carries over rollout boundaries; resets excluded
definitions.advantage_scale: Frozen GAE advantages before per-minibatch normalization; population standard deviation, RMS, mean, extrema and sample count
definitions.entropy: PPO minibatch/sample-weighted entropy, not frozen-policy rollout entropy

required_update_coverage: Every successfully completed update, including valid final partial rollouts; no omitted or duplicate rows. Any update_failure prevents terminal success.
